structural.description: Captured the DataFrame.info() overview without printing it to the console.
Memory is reported in bytes; deep=True includes object/string payload estimates.

completeness.description: The 5% and 30% cutoffs are lecture rules of thumb, not automatic drop-column decisions.
Potential sentinel values are flagged for review; this function does not convert them to NA.

validity.description: Only user-defined domain bounds are applied; values are not corrected or removed.
Duplicate rows are reported for investigation; this function never drops records.
Checks that every source record has a nonblank primary key; no rows are removed.
Checks uniqueness of paper_id independently of full-row duplication.
Detects formatting variants and optional alias-equivalent labels; semantic synonyms require an explicit alias map.

details.description: The number of authors in authors_v1_json should equal author_count_v1.
t0_date should be parseable as a date/time value.
The year in t0_date should equal submission_year.
Team maximum pre-t0 publication count should not be below the team mean.
Team maximum academic age should not be below the team mean.
Influential citations should be a subset of all citations over the same three-year window.
The boolean temporal flag should agree with the DBLP temporal status.

validity.description: Rules are supplied by the project/domain owner; this function does not invent business logic.

distributional.description: Descriptive statistics only; skewness and kurtosis are reported for interpretation, not automatic cleaning decisions.
Potential outliers are flagged for investigation only. IQR flags do not imply invalid values; no records or values are modified.
